lines.text: These are the names of Aaron's sons
Nadab the firstborn and Abihu
Eleazar and Ithamar serve
Anointed priests ordained to minister
But Nadab and Abihu died
Offering unauthorized fire before the Lord
So Eleazar and Ithamar remained
Serving as priests during Aaron's lifetime
The Lord said to Moses bring forward
The tribe of Levi to present them
To Aaron the priest to assist him
Carrying out duties for the whole congregation
I myself have taken the Levites
In place of every firstborn who opens the womb
The Levites shall be mine I am the Lord
For every firstborn is mine from the land of Egypt
Register the sons of Levi by name
Gershon Kohath and Merari their clans
Count every male a month old and older
Moses registered them at the command of the Lord
To Gershon belonged Libni and Shimei
Their enrollment came to seven thousand five hundred
They camped behind the tabernacle west
Caring for the tent and its covering
I myself have taken the Levites
In place of every firstborn who opens the womb
The Levites shall be mine I am the Lord
For every firstborn is mine from the land of Egypt
To Kohath belonged Amram and Izhar
Hebron and Uzziel their clans also
Eight thousand six hundred cared for the sanctuary
Guarding the ark and the table and lampstand
To Merari belonged Mahli and Mushi
Six thousand two hundred cared for the frames
They camped on the north side of the tent
With crossbars and posts and all the equipment
The total number of Levites was twenty-two thousand
Moses and Aaron registered them at the Lord's command
Register every firstborn male of Israel
And record their names as the Lord had commanded
I myself have taken the Levites
In place of every firstborn who opens the womb
The Levites shall be mine I am the Lord
For every firstborn is mine from the land of Egypt
Collect five shekels for each person
Give the silver to Aaron and his sons
The redemption price for those who exceed
The Levites shall be mine I am the Lord

quality: All 48 lyric lines sit on their notes.
